svg.title: Steward architecture as built on September 14, 2026
svg.text: Steward — one agent, one policy owner, one couch
As built and verified locally on September 14, 2026. Solid boxes run today on a developer machine. Dashed boxes are planned hosting targets, not built.
SCREENS — React/Vite build served by FastAPI at / · persona switcher = labeled sandbox, not authentication
Resident intake
Report: description, location,
optional photo → receipt
Crew Form (per vendor)
Accept, check in, attach proof,
submit; rework instruction
Operator: Board · Issue Detail · Inbox
Map, counts, budget; evidence, decisions,
plan, job, proof; action: Request completion
ACCEPTANCE DRIVER — python -m agent.demo
Submits the resident, crew and operator events
through the same HTTP API the screens use and records
every response and agent trace. Sixteen criteria passed
in two independently seeded live runs (Sept 14).
HTTPS (localhost): signed persona cookies, idempotency keys, expected revisions
FastAPI service — src/agent/server.py — the only policy and transaction owner
Code decides: evidence points (image 30, independent sources 20 each ≤ 40, precise location 15, qualifying 311 record 15, persistence 10; actionable at 70) ·
authority and category policy · deterministic quote ($60 + $12 = $72) · budget ledger in integer cents (reserve once, settle once) · verification gates (GPS 30, time 10,
removed 40, no new hazard 10, clear 10; pay at 95) · prerequisites (target present, same scene, no reused photo) · idempotent simulated settlement · closure.
Every mutation checks the actor context and current revision, journals the invocation, and commits state and its audit event together.
SQLite store (.steward/*.sqlite3)
Signals, issues, evidence, plans, jobs, ledger,
exceptions, events, journal (schema 7)
Private image store (.steward/images)
Normalized JPEG bytes, SHA-256 and dHash,
provenance label per image (synthetic / live)
Seeded fixtures — data/ (policy south-loop-v3)
District, $500.00 budget, 3 providers, 10 addresses,
feed, reporters, one COMPLETED 311 record, 5 images
Trusted inspector (src/agent/vision.py)
Loads the exact proof bytes, calls the vision
model, validates findings; code scores them
One Strands agent — prompt steward-investigator-v2 · tools steward-http-tools-v2
Started per accepted event (signal, proof, operator decision); runs in-process next to the API today.
Reads the case packet, then chooses tools: find related signals, search 311, classify, jurisdiction,
plan, vendors, dispatch, inspect, settle, close, escalate, or an explicit MONITOR wait.
It never opens SQLite and cannot set a score, price, budget or human action; tools return facts,
policy results or a denial with the unmet requirement and next actor.
HTTP tools with a service token: facts, policy results, gated mutations, persisted event IDs
API starts each bounded invocation; claims, retries and resume are journaled
Amazon Bedrock — text
global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6
(Claude Sonnet, us-west-2 client)
Chooses the next tool from evidence;
proposes category and responsibility.
Selected by server config, not by the model.
Amazon Bedrock — vision
global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6
(same ID; separately configurable role)
Intake findings: hazards, unknowns.
Completion findings: target present before,
same scene, removed, no new hazard, clear.
structured findings
PLANNED, NOT BUILT (tier 3, owner decision pending — docs/HOSTING_DECISION.md)
AgentCore Runtime
hosts the same one agent; tools still
call the API over HTTPS with a token
AgentCore Observability → CloudWatch
hosted traces of each invocation
(local runs keep JSON traces today)
AgentCore Gateway (last)
MCP tools generated from the API's
OpenAPI; changes transport, not authority
Hosted API + screens, public judging URL
EC2 + EBS + S3 recommended over App Runner;
durable SQLite owner and image store come first

Labels: real = Strands loop, Bedrock inference, scoring, policy, persistence, screens · seeded = district, budget, providers, addresses, feed, reporters, 311 record · synthetic = the images · simulated = dispatch and settlement. No real money.
